nodes.description: Hardcoded constant address of the Easely payout contract used for external splitPayable calls.
Owner-controlled alternate signer allowed to authorize lazy mint and sale signatures.
Basis points taken by the collection owner on secondary sales.
Array of addresses receiving primary sale revenue share.
Array of basis points matching the revenueShare addresses.
Mapping of address to active signature version used to invalidate batches of signatures.
Mapping of order hash to a flag marking a sale or signature as cancelled or already consumed.
Stored owner address used by onlyOwner checks and payout routing.
Running counter of tokens minted; manually updated to save gas.
Running counter of tokens burned.
Mapping of owner address to token balance, updated manually in mint/transfer paths.
Mapping of tokenId to owning address.
Mapping of buyer address to number of tokens minted, used for maxMint enforcement.
Maximum number of tokens that may exist for the collection.
Maximum number of tokens mintable in a single transaction.
Maximum number of tokens a single wallet may mint.
Random shuffle offset applied to tokenURI after reveal.
Starting index offset used when on-chain random minting is enabled at reveal.
Large storage array used for constant-time pseudo-random index generation.
Flag controlling whether token URIs and shuffle logic are revealed.
Base IPFS hash used to compute token URIs.
Guard flag ensuring the init routine may only run once.
Flag enabling or disabling the burn functionality.
Constant hard cap on the collection array size.
Constant number of seconds between price decrements for descending sales.
Constant cap for secondary royalty basis points.
Payable external function letting anyone buy a token via a seller signature; transfers the token then forwards funds to the payout contract.
Payable external function allowing anyone with a valid signer signature to mint tokens.
Payable external allow-list mint restricted by signature to a specific allowedAddress.
Publicly callable function that forwards the contract balance to the payout contract for distribution.
Marks a secondary sale hash as cancelled.
Lets any address update its own active signature version.
Owner-only setter for the alternate signer address.
Owner-only setter for primary revenue share addresses and basis points.
Owner-only setter for secondary royalty basis points.
Owner-only reveal function that sets the IPFS hash, random offset and possibly locks the supply.
External initialization entry point that delegates to _init; guarded only by the hasInit flag.
Internal initialization routine setting owner, signer, royalties, revenue share and supply parameters.
Internal mint wrapper enforcing maxMint, updating balances/totalMinted and choosing incremental or randomized minting.
Internal function generating unique pseudo-random token ids via the indices swap structure.
Internal weak pseudo-random generator using msg.sender, block.difficulty, block.timestamp and blockhash.
Internal view computing the current descending sale price from timestamps and prices.
Internal function validating and consuming a secondary sale signature via hash recovery.
Private function making an external onERC721Received call to contract recipients during safe mint/transfer.
Internal token transfer updating owners and balances.
Internal burn clearing approvals, decreasing balance and incrementing totalBurned.
Internal mint that writes the owner mapping for a token id.
Internal safe mint calling _mint then checking the receiver hook.
Internal setter validating and storing secondary royalty basis points.
Internal setter validating and storing revenue share addresses and basis points.
Internal check that a signer is the owner or the approved alternate signer.
View helper returning the hash an owner/alt signer must sign for an allow-list mint.
View helper returning the hash an owner/alt signer must sign for a general mint.
View helper returning the hash a token owner must sign to sell a token.
Invalidates a general mint signature hash.
Invalidates an allow-list mint signature hash.
External EIP-2981 view returning receiver and royalty amount from a sale price.
View returning totalMinted minus totalBurned.
Internal helper packaging the owner address into a royalties array.
Internal helper packaging ownerRoyaltyBPS into a basis points array.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, minting and randomness.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for sale pricing and randomness.
Origin address placeholder; not used directly but tracked as an untrusted input class.
External value-bearing call to the payout contract inside buyToken after the token transfer.
External value-bearing call to the payout contract in the publicly callable withdrawBalance.
Native ETH refund sent with payable transfer to the caller in mint/mintAllow/buyToken.
ECDSA signature recovery used to authenticate the secondary sale seller.
ECDSA signature recovery used to authenticate the mint signer.
Pseudo-randomness derived from block variables that a miner can bias.
Token ownership is changed before the external payout call, creating a state/external-call ordering hazard.
Integer division computing price decrements inside _currentPrice.
External callback into an arbitrary recipient contract during safe minting.
buyToken parameter identifying the current token owner selling the token.
Array of starting/ending prices and timestamps controlling the sale price.
Buyer-supplied ECDSA signature bytes validated for the sale or mint.
Number of tokens a buyer wishes to mint in mint/mintAllow.
Signature-authorized maximum mint amount; zero means unlimited.
Address restricted by the allow-list signature in mintAllow.
Amount of contract balance to forward in withdrawBalance.
New royalty basis points supplied to setRoyaltiesBPS.
Computed order hash used for cancellation checks and signature recovery.
Computed total mint price used for payment validation and refund.
Recovered signer address validated against the owner or alternate signer.
Remaining unminted supply tracked while generating random indices.

edges.reason: buyToken uses msg.sender as the buyer and refund recipient.
mint uses msg.sender as the minting buyer.
mintAllow requires allowedAddress to equal msg.sender.
The pseudo-random number is derived partly from msg.sender.
_init assigns ownership from msg.sender during initialization.
Sale price depends on block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
Randomness entropy mixes block.timestamp, enabling timestamp bias.
buyToken performs an external value call to the payout contract.
Token state is mutated before the external payout call in buyToken.
buyToken derives the sale price from _currentPrice.
buyToken transfers the token, mutating ownership, before paying out.
buyToken validates and consumes the sale signature via _markHashSold.
buyToken reads the seller's active signature version.
buyToken checks and sets the cancelled-or-finalized sale flag.
_markHashSold recovers the signer with ecrecover to authenticate the seller.
withdrawBalance makes an external value call to the payout contract and is callable by anyone.
withdrawBalance routes funds to the stored owner address.
mint refunds excess ETH with a native transfer to the caller.
mint recovers the signer address from the supplied signature.
mint enforces that the recovered signer is authorized.
mint delegates token creation to _mintRandom.
mint computes unit price through _currentPrice.
mintAllow validates the recovered signer.
mintAllow delegates token creation to _mintRandom.
setRoyaltiesBPS routes the new value through _setRoyaltiesBPS.
_setRoyaltiesBPS writes ownerRoyaltyBPS.
_setRoyaltiesBPS compares against MAX_SECONDARY_BPS using the stale stored value.
lockTokenURI is restricted to the owner through onlyOwner.
lockTokenURI sets the shuffle offset from _random.
lockTokenURI writes the revealed IPFS hash.
updateVersion writes the caller's active signature version.
updateVersion keys the version mapping on msg.sender.
_mintRandom calls _mintRandomIndex when the collection is revealed.
_mintRandom safe mints sequentially when not revealed.
_mintRandomIndex relies on _random to pick indices.
_mintRandomIndex safe mints the computed random token ids.
_random builds entropy from block variables that a miner can manipulate.
_currentPrice uses integer division to compute price decrements.
_currentPrice divides elapsed time by TIME_PER_DECREMENT.
_mintRandom increments the buyer balance mapping.
_mintRandom increments the total minted counter.
_mintRandom enforces and updates the per-wallet mint count.
_mintRandom branches on the isRevealed flag.
_transfer decrements and increments the balance mapping.
_transfer rewrites the owner mapping for the token id.
_burn increments the total burned counter.
_burn decrements the owner balance.
_mint writes the owner mapping.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external call into the recipient contract.
A malicious recipient hook can re-enter buyToken during safe transfer/mint.
A malicious recipient hook can re-enter mint while the mint is in progress.
The external init function has no caller restriction and only the hasInit flag guards it.
_init sets the contract owner from the caller.
setAltSigner writes the alternate signer address.
_checkValidSigner accepts the alternate signer as an authorized signer.
_checkValidSigner accepts the owner as an authorized signer.
setRevenueShare routes new values through _setRevenueShare.
_setRevenueShare writes the revenue share addresses.
_setRevenueShare writes the revenue share basis points.
_setRevenueShare validates total bps against MAX_ROYALTIES_BPS.
pricesAndTimestamps feeds the price and timestamp computation.
signature bytes are consumed when recovering the sale signer.
buyAmount determines how many tokens mint allocates.
The computed hash is the message passed to ecrecover.
totalPrice determines the ETH refunded to the caller.
The recovered signer address is validated for authorization.
supplyLeft bounds the range passed to _random.

normalization_plan.reason: seller is a buyToken parameter used only to identify the selling owner in that function.
The price/timestamp array is consumed by _currentPrice to derive the sale price.
The signature bytes are only used for signer recovery inside _markHashSold.
buyAmount is a mint-specific parameter governing token allocation.
amount is the signature-authorized mint cap evaluated in mint.
allowedAddress is the allow-list recipient checked in mintAllow.
withdrawAmount is the amount forwarded by withdrawBalance.
newBPS is the input handled by setRoyaltiesBPS.
The local hash is produced and used within _markHashSold.
totalPrice is a local computed and consumed inside mint.
signer is a local recovered and checked within mint.
supplyLeft is a loop-local counter used by _mintRandomIndex.
